title: Skill Meditate
wikitext: == General == Meditate greatly improves mana regeneration rates. Without it, you only gain 2 mana (per tick) when sitting. * For every 12 points your Meditate skill has, you will regenerate +1 mana (per tick) when sitting. * As long as you have trained 1 point into it, Meditate automatically happens when sitting. * Whether you have Meditate or not, you will only gain 1 mana (per tick) when standing. A "tick" happens every 6 seconds (server side). * It does not matter whether you are sitting or standing between seconds 1 and 5, only the 6th second. == Classes == * [[Enchanter]] '''Level 4''' (Max 252) * [[Magician]] '''Level 4''' (Max 252) * [[Necromancer]] '''Level 4''' (Max 252) * [[Wizard]] '''Level 4''' (Max 252) * [[Cleric]] '''Level 8''' (Max 252) * [[Druid]] '''Level 8''' (Max 252) * [[Shaman]] '''Level 8''' (Max 252) * [[Bard]] '''Level 10''' (Max 1) * [[Ranger]] '''Level 11''' (Max 226) * [[Paladin]] '''Level 12''' (Max 235) * [[Shadow Knight]] '''Level 12''' (Max 235) At level 46, caster classes are capped at 235 until level == Regen Table == {| class='eoTable2' style="text-align: center;" !
